IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy brown
hair and a white bow hair clip stands full-length
against a light gray backdrop. She wears a fitted
white mesh cap-sleeve top with a black bow
graphic across the chest. A medium wash denim
midi skirt with a ruffled asymmetric slit and a brown
belt with a plush bear charm sits at the waist. Black
crossbody bag, patterned socks, and chunky silver
sneakers complete the look. Her expression is
calm, with one hand raised to her hair. Soft, even
studio light. Palette of white, faded denim, and
charcoal. Playful and feminine, in the style of a Y2K
lookbook.
